messages:
Ana: Quick preflight — need to align on launch criteria + cross-team deps for the Predictive Cache pilot. Can product/eng/runtime/infra/security confirm owners and gating items? TL;DR: capacity targets, latency SLO, KMS onboarding, quantization profile, and rollback plan. @Kevin @Shivam @Lisa @Marta

Kevin: Got it. Need expected peak QPS and avg seq len to size batching and prewarm. Also, which model/quant variant are we pinning for rollout?

Marta: Customer asks: 99th percentile correctness on our eval set must stay within 2% of baseline. Peak per-tenant QPS estimate: 120 rps for initial pilot tenant (burst to 300). Seq len typical 128 tokens. We'll own rollout criteria and customer comms.

Shivam: Infra notes: prewarm slots + autoscale policy required. For burst to 300 we want prewarm=6 on dedicated pool and a max of 30 nodes for safety. KMS integration needs a contact and a test vector to validate encryption-at-rest. Also, we need a staging smoke test that simulates 3x traffic.

Lisa: Security checklist: KMS + HSM sign-off, threat model for cached prompts (prefix caching), and audit logs enabled for private pilot. We also need to confirm data residency for that customer. I can run the threat-model session if we schedule it this week.

Kevin: Proposed runtime SLOs to start with (feel free to push back):
```
runtime: 
  batch_window_ms: 20
  autoscale: 
    min_instances: 2
    prewarm_instances: 6
    max_instances: 30
slo: 
  p95_latency_ms (512 tokens): 150
  p99_latency_ms (512 tokens): 450
  error_rate: < 0.5%
```
Those numbers assume the quantized 4-bit variant and tokenizer warm cache. If we use the FP16 variant, p95 improves ~20-30ms but cost rises.

Marta: That SLO looks reasonable for pilot. For launch gating, add: no more than 1 P1 incident in a rolling 7-day window during canary, and latency regressions must be flagged by our eval harness before GA.

Ana: OK — let's capture ownership: Marta = rollout gating & customer comms; Kevin = runtime performance + canary metrics; Shivam = infra capacity + autoscale; Lisa = security gating & KMS sign-off. Can everyone confirm?

Kevin: Confirmed. I'll produce a short perf-run doc with traces and expected token-level cost by EOD tomorrow.

Shivam: Confirmed. I'll open infra ticket with autoscale config + prewarm request and attach the staging smoke test plan.

Lisa: Confirmed. I'll schedule threat-model and KMS sign-off; need the KMS contact from the customer (Marta can share).

Marta: Confirmed. Sharing KMS contact and customer residency requirements in the tracker. I'll also publish the customer eval set to the eval harness (read-only) for regression checks.

ops-bot: tracker created: https://ourtracker/PD-4521 — fields: owner=Marta, subsystems=runtime,infra,security, target_mvp_date=2026-04-12

Ana: Nice. One ask: keep the canary small and watch prefix-caching telemetry closely (we don't want cold-cache regressions to slip). Kevin — can you add a metric for cache-hit-ratio per tenant?

Kevin: Yep — will add cache_hit_ratio and kv_cache_evictions to the canary dashboard. Also will expose token-cost-per-request so PMs can see unit economics in real time.

Marta: I'll own the go/no-go checklist entry for quality/regressions. Suggest this roll sequence: internal canary (10% traffic), pilot tenant (100% for that tenant), then staged GA.

Ana: Sounds good. Thanks everyone — I'll update the roadmap doc with these owners and the gating checklist, link PD-4521, and circle back with a short timeline. :thumbsup:

Lisa: +1 :lock:

Kevin: :rocket:

Shivam: :gear:

Marta: :spiral_calendar_pad:
